summary: Apply lender ESMS methods to borrower screening, due diligence and credit controls. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Environmental and social risk management systems training helps lending and financial-intermediary teams connect borrower risks with financing decisions. It covers screening and risk categorization, planning due diligence, reviewing evidence, and translating findings into credit conditions and follow-up. Participants practise tracking corrective actions, monitoring portfolios and documenting decisions so credit, risk, and environmental and social teams can work from a shared assessment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for lending and financial-intermediary professionals who review borrowers, approve or monitor financing, or advise on environmental and social controls. It suits practitioners with working exposure to credit or risk processes who need to apply consistent E&S steps across cases.
modules: Lender ESMS Governance and IFC Standards
IFC PS2 Labour and Working Conditions
IFC PS5 Land and Livelihood Risks
World Bank Group EHS Sector Controls
prerequisites: Working knowledge of credit origination, credit risk or financial-intermediary operations, plus familiarity with basic environmental and social risk concepts. No coding or programming is required.
